description: Show a rendered video to the user in an inline player (with duration and a download link). Call it when render_video, check_status or list_recent_renders report a video as done: pass its url and, when known, project and duration. Use it instead of only pasting the link.

height.description: Video height in pixels, if known

title.description: Title to show above the player

url.description: The video (MP4) URL returned by render_video / check_status

width.description: Video width in pixels, if known

name: show_video
title: Show video
